description: Send a message to an existing session by its session id or subagent run id. A subagent waiting for a message resumes with it; a running subagent takes it at its next iteration boundary; any other session starts a new turn carrying it. The target must belong to this profile — another profile's session, your own session, or an unknown id is refused.
name: sessions_send

message.description: Message to deliver to that session.

sessionKey.description: Session id or subagent run id to message.
